title: The Business Plot against FDR

tellings.quote: They're going to raise an army of like 500,000 people and march to Washington and forcefully remove the president from office.

plain: A podcast guest who goes by the name JASON tells Jesse Michels about the so-called Business Plot of the 1930s. He says wealthy figures tied to the Morgan banking and DuPont industrial fortunes planned to raise an army of about 500,000 men, march on Washington and remove President Franklin Roosevelt by force, with Smedley Butler, a retired Marine general, named in the story. He tells it to show that powerful private networks have tried to steer the US government from behind the scenes.
